gate: LEARN-IQ (Phase 110 intent-bucketed usefulness + citation attribution, Tracks H1 + H3)
systemUnderTest: the Phase-110 learning mechanism end-to-end (LEARN-01 the per-intent usefulness read on the recall hot path + the per-intent write-back the daemon subscriber drives + LEARN-02 the dialectic citation->FEED emit from the memory.ask handler + the offline usefulness-judge scaffold shipped DEFAULT-OFF + the keyless mechanical gate)

models.note: The KEYLESS run that backs this manifest calls NO model: it seeds the per-intent usefulness store DIRECTLY via recordUsage (the write path the daemon subscriber drives) and runs the LLM-free createMemoryRecall (the recall hot path is deterministic + LLM-free; the per-intent read does NO second classify and makes 0 model calls). The offline usefulness judge ships DEFAULT-OFF and is NOT run here (scaffold only -- Plan 110-05). The model block records the INTENDED costed-pass configuration (the same answerer + cross-MODEL judge pair as the 2026-06-01-phase106-baser baseline) for the DEFERRED costed learning-LIFT ONLY. cross-PROVIDER judging is the costed re-run; an answerer must never be its own provider's judge.

measurementsTaken.name: per-intent bucket drives the recall order (LEARN-01)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS - a memory recorded used-for-intent-X (a high used-rate in the X bucket, none in the Y bucket) ranks HIGHER for an X-classified query than for a Y-classified query (mRankForUsedForIntentQuery=1 < mRankForOtherIntentQuery=2). Only the fts lane is lit, so the lane-reweight has no lane to move -- the SOLE intent-driven difference is the per-intent USEFULNESS bucket. The two queries are picked so the DETERMINISTIC classifyIntent lands them in different buckets; the harness measures the OBSERVABLE rank effect and never imports classifyIntent (Pitfall 2). Mechanical, keyless, $0 -- NOT a learning-LIFT.

measurementsTaken.name: default-OFF byte-identity + readUsefulness spy=0 (the cost gate)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS - with feedback OFF the recall order is byte-identical to a store-absent run (defaultOffByteIdentical=true) AND readUsefulness is NEVER called (readUsefulnessCalls=0), even with a reorder-strength per-intent bucket seeded + intentReweight ON. The OFF gate skips the usefulness read entirely (the no-op cost gate -- the readEmbeddings-spy=0 precedent). Mechanical, keyless, $0 -- NOT a learning-LIFT.

measurementsTaken.name: citation->FEED accrual (LEARN-02)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS - a cited id's usefulness accrues: recordUsage(usedIds=[cited], ignoredIds=[other]) (the GLOBAL bucket -- the dialectic emit shape from Plan 110-04, the handler does not re-classify) then readUsefulness shows the cited id's used-count incremented 0->1 (citedUsedCountAfter=1) and its used-rate strictly higher than the ignored sibling's (citedUsedRate=1.0 > otherUsedRate=0.0). This is the store-level accrual the dialectic citation emit feeds the SHIPPED FEED write path; the handler emit itself is RED-proven in the daemon handler tests (Plan 110-04). Mechanical, keyless, $0 -- NOT a learning-LIFT.

measurementsTaken.name: tenant/agent/intent isolation (the load-bearing security scope)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS - a usefulness write under (tenantA, agentA, intentX) is INVISIBLE to a foreign-tenant read (tenantB, agentA) AND to a foreign-agent read (tenantA, agentB): inScopePresent=true, foreignTenantPresent=false, foreignAgentPresent=false. (tenant, agent) stay the load-bearing isolation boundary (T-110-03 / T-93-01); intent is an ADDITIONAL key, never a relaxation. The memory_id is byte-identical across the reads -- the isolation is the scope, not the id. Mechanical, keyless, $0 -- NOT a learning-LIFT.

deferredToOperator.name: the costed rank-over-episodes learning-LIFT (the learning accuracy number)
deferredToOperator.why: Needs the H2 outcome-driven re-rank (the bandit) AND a costed run over N episodes of the SAME query to measure whether a repeatedly-attributed gold memory's rank LIFTS as the FEED loop learns -- a positive, bounded lift with zero regression on the v2.9 baseline. That run needs a real answer model + a real LLM judge (cross-judge >=2 per the credibility protocol) to attribute usefulness over real answers, plus the costed enablement of the offline usefulness judge (shipped DEFAULT-OFF here as a scaffold only). All of it costs real spend + keys. The keyless bench seeds the buckets directly + uses synthetic fixtures, so it proves the MECHANISM at $0 (per-intent ordering, default-OFF cost gate, citation accrual, isolation) but produces no learning-lift number; a fresh lift number here would be fabricated.
deferredToOperator.reproductionCommand: populate scripts/bench-memory.env (COMIS_BENCH + COMIS_BENCH_ANSWER_* + COMIS_BENCH_JUDGE_* variable NAMES -- NO values recorded here), enable the H2 re-rank + the offline usefulness judge with a real provider key, then run packages/agent/src/memory/benchmark/learning-lift-harness.bench.test.ts over N episodes of the same query (scoreLearningLift folds the gold doc's per-episode rank into rankLift = firstRank - lastRank); record per-category rank lift + zero-regression + N + significance + cost + latency.
deferredToOperator.baselineToDiffAgainst: benchmarks/results/2026-06-01-phase106-baser/ (the v2.9 baseline the recall hot path must not move when learning is off)

honestyProtocol: Every number traces to a committed claim*-report.json, read back from disk before quoting. The four mechanical claims (per-intent-bucket-drives-order, default-OFF-byte-identity + read-spy=0, citation->FEED-accrual, tenant/agent/intent-isolation) are each labelled 'mechanical, keyless, $0 -- NOT a learning-LIFT' and kept STRICTLY SEPARATE from the costed rank-over-episodes learning-LIFT (explicitly DEFERRED to Phase 111 / LEARN-04, NOT a guessed delta). The keyless bench calls no answer model, no judge, no key, no provider: it seeds the per-intent usefulness store directly and runs the LLM-free createMemoryRecall (the per-intent read does no second classify -- 0 model calls). A post-run credential-shape sweep over the manifest is clean: it carries pure numbers + booleans + prose, no credential field names or secret-key/bearer-token shapes. This run ships DEFAULT-OFF (no committed config enables feedback or the offline usefulness judge).
